description: Suryalakshmi Cotton Mills Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of cotton and blended yarns, denim fabrics, and garments in India, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Guatemala, Kenya, Mauritius, Madagascar, South Korea, and internationally. The company offers yarns, such as cotton, polyester, viscose, ring spun fibres, and blended yarns. It provides a range of denim fabrics, including coloured, mercerized, dyed, coated, stretch, and rigid fabrics. It serves private labels, fashion brands, and retail chains. The company was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Secunderabad, India.
